svg.title: ALiBi causal distance-bias sweep
svg.desc: Illustrative causal softmax with eight equal content logits. For key distance d, the ALiBi bias is negative m times d; each normalized weight equals exp(-m d) divided by the sum of eight exponentials. At slope zero the distribution is uniform and increasing the slope concentrates probability near the current token.
